title: Ina's Debut Stream
context: The first time Ina introduced herself to the world as Ninomae Ina'nis, the priestess destined to bring about the end of the world, and instead brought six years of art, music and laughter with her.

reactions.author: Rozenity
reactions.text: Where it all started. The creation of the Tentacult. The overwhelming power of Ina's giggles. Of Ina's comfy energy. From the comfy and iconic intro BGM and the bouncing takodachi, to Ina showcasing her anime list and her hobbies, I knew then and there that you were gonna be my kami oshi! I was one of the few takodachis that, if given the chance, would've joined the membership on day 1

reactions.author: Notar
reactions.text: Ina ina ina! Ina ina!

reactions.author: Kurasu Kanon
reactions.text: Where it all started. I instantly became a Takodachi when I watched the debut stream!

title: Thank you!!!
context: Barely a week in and your channel received monetization! Lots of superchats and 10Qs all around, and you sung us your favorite Aimer song! Also delicious fire noodles...

title: Color Out of Space Watchalong!
context: Your very first watchalong! We definitely had our sanity tested this stream, but this is a movie that has stood the test of time--we still reference it to this day!

reactions.author: Scalim
reactions.text: First Watchalong i ever did! always fun to watch movies or anime with you, specially when its something i wouldnt watch normally by myself. 💜🐙

reactions.author: Reyk
reactions.text: This is some of your first ever stream that i've ever watched that were the most memorable to me till now. I still remembered back then i was like:"wow, she knows Color Out of Space, that was so cool" and there was so much fun watching the move along with you and many other takos. This is one of my first step of becoming a tako, and i always cherish this a lot (= w=)9

title: Creative Title #325
context: The day your memberships opened--finally we understood how we would evolve from our void forms! Still didn't expect to find the key to the boiler room here...

reactions.author: Scalim
reactions.text: Arkham Editions? Never heard of them.

title: There is Pasta Among Us
context: The first collab with NePoLaBo and HoloMyth playing Among Us--this is the very first time we learnt that Ina is actually a yandere (somewhat)! Also the beginning of a love story between a seal and tako...

title: Gesture Drawing + Doodle #6
context: Congratulations on 500k subscribers, Ina! The usual gesture drawing is always helpful to see, and the doodle with you wearing glasses is super cute. Glasses are really versatile...

reactions.author: zeroyaka
reactions.text: Always love watching Ina's art streams in general. I like learning things in art and marveling at the priestess' skills in art ✍(◔◡◔)

title: #WAHnMILLION YAKISOBAAAaaaa

title: 『VIOLET』 - Ninomae Ina'nis

reactions.text: The first original song, and it couldn't have been a better start. I've listened to it countless times, and it will always seem flawless to me. STEAM VIOLET, MECONOPSIS and TEMARI

reactions.author: Minja
reactions.text: Violet is just such a beautiful and unique song. Ina has sung many times before this, but this just reminded me of how good Ina is at singing. Every time I hear this song I'm just hit with a massive wave of nostalgia and happy emotions that just make me smile.

title: It's been a WAHnderful Year!!!! #WAHnniversary
context: It really has been a WAHnderful year! (Though, the mental damage you suffered from watching your debut stream probably wasn't all that wahnderful...) Congratulations on your 1st debut anniversary! May you achieve much this year as well, we'll be here to support you every step of the way!

title: A Whole Year of...!?!? #Mythiversary
context: Hey, this was last year! Not today, not yesterday, not a few days ago... Crazy how it's already been a year! Congratulations to you and Myth on your first debut anniversary! Thank you for all your hard work, and we'll be sure to support all of you from now on too! Also the smol models were really cute!

sourceLabel: [Original MV] Domination! All the World Is an Ocean
